quotes: “ Why did you come ? ”
“ I will not let you stay . Send my Ayah to me . ”
“ Pig ! Pig ! Daughter of Pigs ! ”
“ Is it so very bad ? Oh , is it ? ”
“ Awfully , ”
“ Awfully , Mrs. Lennox . You ought to have gone to the hills two weeks ago . ”
“ Oh , I know I ought ! ”
“ I only stayed to go to that silly dinner party . What a fool I was ! ”
“ What is it ? What is it ? ”
“ Some one has died , ”
“ You did not say it had broken out among your servants . ”
“ I did not know ! ”
“ Come with me ! Come with me ! ”
“ How queer and quiet it is , ”
“ It sounds as if there were no one in the bungalow but me and the snake . ”
“ What desolation ! ”
“ That pretty , pretty woman ! I suppose the child , too . I heard there was a child , though no one ever saw her . ”
“ Barney ! ”
“ There is a child here ! A child alone ! In a place like this ! Mercy on us , who is she ! ”
“ I am Mary Lennox , ”
“ I fell asleep when everyone had the cholera and I have only just wakened up . Why does nobody come ? ”
“ It is the child no one ever saw ! ”
“ She has actually been forgotten ! ”
